newsitem.title: FRANCE: Delors hit by cream pie in French campaign.
newsitem.headline: Delors hit by cream pie in French campaign.

text.p: Former European Commission president Jacques Delors was hit in the face with a cream pie made with shaving foam at a French election rally in the Alpine city of Grenoble on Tuesday night, witnesses said.
Two unidentified assailants rushed Delors, 71, as he walked to the podium. A self-styled committee against the Maastricht treaty on European union claimed responsibility for the attack.
Delors suffered a slight cut but went ahead with his campaign speech for the opposition Socialist party after wiping blood and shaving foam from his face.
He said he did not intend to file a police complaint but the attack showed that violence lurked just below the surface of French politics.

A respected elder statesman who was French finance minister from 1981 to 1984 and president of the executive European Commission from 1985 to 1994, Delors was one of the architects of a single European currency, due to be launched in 1999.
He has endorsed the French Socialists's conditions for entering European monetary union.
